primary_design.unit: Independent rejected typed skill proposal paired with one frozen version-space state
primary_design.outcome: Binary admission success within the same predeclared request and resource budget
primary_design.comparison: Separating-witness feedback versus fact-equivalent flat feedback
primary_design.test: One-sided exact conditional McNemar/sign test on discordant pairs
primary_design.null: Conditional treatment-win probability among discordant pairs q <= 0.5

alternative_parameters.r: Probability that the two feedback arms are discordant
alternative_parameters.q: Probability that treatment wins conditional on discordance

primary_design.calculation: For each total pair count N, integrate exact conditional rejection probability over D ~ Binomial(N,r); for each D use the smallest integer k with P[Binomial(D,0.5) >= k] <= 0.05.

eight_pair_canary.claim_boundary: Eight proposal pairs cannot serve as a confirmatory publication-level study under any displayed scenario.

recommended_two_stage_use.stage_1: Use eight prospectively generated pairs only to validate packet equivalence, teacher determinism, transport accounting, and estimate the discordance rate without making an efficacy claim.
recommended_two_stage_use.stage_2: Freeze r and q planning assumptions from an outcome-blind or alpha-accounted rule, then collect the table-defined total pair count in an independent expansion.
recommended_two_stage_use.illustrative_conservative_target: If r=0.30 and q=0.70 are the minimum relevant alternative, 138 total independent pairs give at least 80% power and 186 give at least 90% power.
recommended_two_stage_use.multiplicity_boundary: The table assumes one final test and no unaccounted interim looks; sequential monitoring requires the paper's alpha-spending mechanism and a new power calculation.

non_claims: The assumed r and q values are planning scenarios, not estimates from current data.
This analysis does not authorize proposal generation, model calls, freezing, dispatch, or endpoint changes.
Power does not repair nonexchangeable proposal units, opened outcomes, packet nonequivalence, or invalid custody.
